runs.purpose: A watchdog timer: it exposes control registers (enable, lock, strict, timeout) to a bus, samples a prescaled tick input, increments an internal counter while enabled, detects a timeout or access-fault condition and produces a hardware reset output (rstn_o), and records the reset cause; it also exports clkgen_en_o (copies enable).

flows.value: writes that set the watchdog control registers (enable, lock, strict, timeout)
watchdog enable captured and used to start counting (sets cnt_started)
prescaler tick drives cnt_inc and the counter increments while started
the reset-cause value is selected and stored (ext/dbg/timeout/access)
bus read returns control fields and the stored reset cause on bus_rsp_o.data
lock bit prevents software writes to the control registers and causes reset_force on write attempts when locked
timeout reset: when cnt_started and cnt == ctrl.timeout a hw timeout is produced and rstn_o is driven (system reset)
access-forced reset: illegal/unauthorised writes set reset_force, which (when strict and enabled) produces hw_rst_access and drives rstn_o
watchdog internal reset of the counter: a correct-password bus write sets reset_wdt which clears cnt

runs.purpose: The watchdog block accepts bus configuration and reload requests, runs a prescaled counter when enabled, compares the counter against a programmable timeout and, on timeout or forced-access conditions, asserts a hardware reset output; it also reports control fields and the reset cause on the bus and exports a clock-enable signal.

flows.value: Control register fields (enable, lock, strict, timeout) written into internal ctrl record by bus writes to the control address
Watchdog reload / clear request (reset_wdt) set by a bus write of the correct password
Prescaler tick (from clkgen_i) drives cnt_started and increments cnt; when cnt equals ctrl.timeout (cnt_timeout) hw_rst_timeout is produced
Readback of control fields and reset cause returned on bus reads into bus_rsp_o.data
The lock bit freezes control writes (attempts to write while locked cause reset_force)
System reset output rstn_o asserted when hw_rst_timeout or hw_rst_access are set; reset_cause captured accordingly

runs.purpose: Watchdog timer with a bus-accessible control register set (enable/lock/strict/timeout), a prescaler input, a 24-bit counter that increments on prescaler ticks, and reset generation (timeout or forced-access). It exports an enable bit and a system reset output and reports registers / reset cause over the bus.

flows.value: Write the control registers (enable, lock, strict, timeout) from bus requests into the module's ctrl record
Password-protected software reset of the watchdog (write reset password to trigger reset_wdt)
Prescaler-driven watchdog counting: prsc_tick enables cnt_inc/cnt_started; cnt increments and when cnt == ctrl.timeout cnt_timeout is asserted (leading to hw_rst_timeout)
Readback of control bits and reset cause on bus_rsp_o.data in response to bus reads
Locking the control register: ctrl.lock freezes further control writes and causes a forced-reset flag on write attempts when locked
Resets: (a) external system reset rstn_sys_i clears registers and counters; (b) hardware resets are produced from timeout or forced-access and driven out on rstn_o; reset_cause is recorded
